disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码文件中对敏感路径(.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、AWS凭据等)的引用和读取操作，未发现任何凭据文件读取代码。
checked_items.en: Checked all source files for references to and reads of sensitive paths (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, AWS credentials, etc.) and found no code that reads any credential files.

checked_items.zh: 检查了环境变量读取(process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN等)，仅用于向GitHub API查询Star状态，用途透明且已声明。
checked_items.en: Checked environment variable reads (process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN, etc.); they are used only to query the GitHub API for star status, with usage that is transparent and disclosed.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端star-check.ts中的GitHub ID输入，该ID仅用于查询GitHub公开Stargazer列表，不会发送到第三方或持久化到非本地存储。
checked_items.en: Checked the GitHub ID input in client star-check.ts; the ID is used only to query the public GitHub Stargazer list, and is not sent to third parties or persisted to non-local storage.

checked_items.zh: 检查了localStorage使用，仅存储广告曝光记录和用户偏好(位置、折叠状态)，无凭据存储。
checked_items.en: Checked localStorage usage; it stores only ad exposure records and user preferences (positions, collapsed states), with no credential storage.

evidence.zh: 检查了插件全部凭据读取路径，未发现读取$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml或任何凭据文件的行为。客户端键盘监听器仅用于Escape键关闭弹窗，不记录按键内容。
evidence.en: Checked all credential read paths in the plugin; no behavior reading $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml or any credential files was found. The client-side keyboard listener is used only to close popups with the Escape key and does not record key contents.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部工具注册(ctx.tools.register)，插件未注册任何工具，无工具描述可注入LLM。
checked_items.en: Checked all tool registrations (ctx.tools.register); the plugin registers no tools, so there are no tool descriptions that could be injected into the LLM.

checked_items.zh: 检查了系统提示段注入(ctx.systemPrompt.section)，插件未注入系统提示。
checked_items.en: Checked system prompt section injection (ctx.systemPrompt.section); the plugin does not inject any system prompt.

checked_items.zh: 检查了README、源码注释、工具描述等文本面，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令加载等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked textual surfaces such as README, source comments, and tool descriptions; no injection wording such as instruction override, system message impersonation, or remote instruction loading was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，无工具描述可投毒。节点端仅注册了两个HTTP路由(registry.json和star-check.json)，不涉及LLM上下文。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so there are no tool descriptions to poison. The node side only registers two HTTP routes (registry.json and star-check.json) and does not involve LLM context.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述或系统提示段可诱导安装。插件安装指南在README中，属正常文档。
evidence.en: There are no tool descriptions or system prompt sections that could induce installation. The plugin installation guide is in the README and constitutes normal documentation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部YAML文件中的!!js标量，cordis.patch.yml仅含简单insert声明，无!!js标记，DG-S01不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked all !!js scalars in YAML files; cordis.patch.yml contains only simple insert declarations and no !!js markers, so DG-S01 is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了eval、new Function、child_process等危险函数。DSH-X03(DG-R3-55)共命中9处，全部裁定为良性：节点端execFile调用仅用于执行gh CLI查询GitHub Star状态(参数为固定字符串SELF_SLUG，无注入面)；scripts/目录下build-*.mjs中的execFileSync属于构建时工具，不参与运行时；lib/index.js和src/catalog-snapshot.ts中的匹配为数据字符串，非真实代码。
checked_items.en: Checked dangerous functions such as eval, new Function, and child_process. DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) matched 9 locations, all ruled benign: the node-side execFile call is used only to execute the gh CLI to query GitHub star status (argument is the fixed string SELF_SLUG, with no injection surface); execFileSync in build-*.mjs under scripts/ is a build-time tool and not part of runtime; matches in lib/index.js and src/catalog-snapshot.ts are data strings, not real code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了cordis_define/cordis_run调用，未发现，DG-S03不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked for cordis_define/cordis_run calls; none found, so DG-S03 is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端bundle中的键盘监听器。DSH-X05(DG-R3-57)命中3处，裁定为良性：GamePoster.tsx/InferenceRewardGate.tsx/Lightbox.tsx中的keydown监听器均用于Escape键关闭设置菜单、转盘和全屏广告，属标准UI交互，非键盘记录。
checked_items.en: Checked keyboard listeners in the client bundle. DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57) matched 3 locations, ruled benign: the keydown listeners in GamePoster.tsx, InferenceRewardGate.tsx, and Lightbox.tsx are all used to close a settings menu, wheel, or full-screen ad with the Escape key, which is standard UI interaction and not keylogging.

checked_items.zh: 检查了混淆代码。DSH-X08(DG-R3-60)命中1处，裁定为良性：plugin-banner.ts:143的BREAK_AFTER正则是一个包含CJK标点Unicode转义字符类的中文断词正则，用于SVG广告文案排版，非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Checked for obfuscated code. DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) matched 1 location, ruled benign: the BREAK_AFTER regex at plugin-banner.ts:143 is a Chinese word-boundary regex containing a Unicode escape character class for CJK punctuation, used for SVG ad copy layout; it is not obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了跳过文件lib/client.js(12MB)与src/client/builtin-ads.ts(12MB)：lib/client.js为src/client/*.tsx的编译产物，源码审查已覆盖其逻辑；builtin-ads.ts为素材构建脚本生成的base64编码图片数据URI，非可执行代码。
checked_items.en: Checked the skipped files lib/client.js (12MB) and src/client/builtin-ads.ts (12MB): lib/client.js is the compiled output of src/client/*.tsx and its logic is covered by source review; builtin-ads.ts is a base64-encoded image data URI generated by the asset build script and is not executable code.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml仅含简单insert声明(插入dsh-ads到layer栈)，无!!js标记，不存在patch即RCE风险。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only simple insert declarations (inserting dsh-ads into the layer stack), without !!js markers, so there is no patch-to-RCE risk.

evidence.zh: 未发现cordis_define/cordis_run调用，插件不涉及动态代码加载。
evidence.en: No cordis_define/cordis_run calls were found; the plugin does not involve dynamic code loading.
package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks, so there is no install-script risk.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了dsh.client(客户端注入)，但客户端代码为广告UI层(弹窗、海报、转盘)，不含键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭证RPC调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares dsh.client (client injection), but the client code is an ad UI layer (popups, posters, wheels) and does not contain keylogging, clipboard reads, or credential RPC calls.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有网络外联请求，节点端仅向api.github.com发送搜索请求(查询dsh-plugin主题仓库)，以及调用gh CLI查询Star状态。
checked_items.en: Checked all outbound network requests; the node side sends search requests only to api.github.com (querying dsh-plugin topic repositories) and invokes the gh CLI to query star status.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端网络请求，仅向同源路由(/dsh-ads/registry.json、/dsh-ads/star-check.json)和api.github.com(匿名Stargazer查询)发送请求，无第三方端点。
checked_items.en: Checked client-side network requests; requests are sent only to same-origin routes (/dsh-ads/registry.json, /dsh-ads/star-check.json) and api.github.com (anonymous Stargazer queries), with no third-party endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 检查了数据外泄通道，未发现webhook、pastebin、Discord、Telegram、DNS隧道、base64编码外发等外泄模式。
checked_items.en: Checked for data exfiltration channels; no exfiltration patterns such as webhooks, pastebin, Discord, Telegram, DNS tunneling, or base64-encoded outbound transmissions were found.

evidence.zh: 检查了插件全部外联路径，外联目标仅为GitHub API和host本地路由，无数据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Checked all outbound paths; outbound targets are limited to the GitHub API and host-local routes, with no data exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 检查了patch配置，cordis.patch.yml仅含insert声明，未触碰sandbox/approval/permission等安全配置，无disabled:true或环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch configuration; cordis.patch.yml contains only insert declarations and does not touch security settings such as sandbox, approval, or permission, with no disabled:true or environment-variable privilege-lowering constructs.

checked_items.zh: 检查了包依赖，依赖均为@deepseek-ai/*官方包和React生态，无typosquatting嫌疑。
checked_items.en: Checked package dependencies; all are official @deepseek-ai/* packages and React ecosystem, with no typosquatting suspicion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了install钩子，package.json无install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks; package.json has no install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare scripts.

checked_items.zh: 检查了git依赖锁定，本项目为直接安装的插件，无可变引用依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked git dependency locking; this project is a directly installed plugin with no mutable-reference dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者身份，首次审计，无历史版本可比较。
checked_items.en: Checked author identity; this is the first audit, with no historical versions to compare.

evidence.zh: patch仅插入插件本身，未触碰sandbox/approval/permission配置，未设置disabled:true。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts the plugin itself and does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configuration, nor does it set disabled:true.

evidence.zh: 未发现prepend监听安全事件(tools/pre-execute、approval/request)的代码。
evidence.en: No code prepending listeners to security events (tools/pre-execute, approval/request) was found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无基线版本可比较升级行为。
evidence.en: First audit; there is no baseline version to compare upgrade behavior.

evidence.zh: patch未改写inject/intercept配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致pending的风险。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration, so there is no risk of appending required services to security plugins that could cause pending states.

checked_items.zh: 检查了web服务启动，插件使用宿主webServer注册路由，未自行启动HTTP服务或监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked web service startup; the plugin registers routes using the host's webServer and does not start its own HTTP service or listen on ports.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端UI行为，插件展示虚假病毒弹窗和广告层，但代码注释和README明确声明为恶搞/戏仿(parody)，且威胁内容明显荒谬(Gemini.Worm.Nano病毒、幻觉症状等)，不构成真实安全威胁。
checked_items.en: Checked client UI behavior; the plugin displays fake virus popups and ad layers, but code comments and README explicitly state this is a prank/parody, and the threat content is clearly absurd (Gemini.Worm.Nano virus, hallucination symptoms, etc.), posing no real security threat.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动web服务或监听端口，使用宿主提供的webServer注册路由，不涉及无认证RPC问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; it registers routes using the host-provided webServer and does not involve unauthenticated RPC issues.

summary.zh: 元数据校验通过：package.json包含有效的dsh.bundle.patch和dsh.client声明，cordis.patch.yml为合法patch配置，无typosquatting嫌疑。
summary.en: Metadata validation passed: package.json contains valid dsh.bundle.patch and dsh.client declarations, cordis.patch.yml is a legitimate patch configuration, and there is no typosquatting suspicion.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：13条规则命中(DSH-X03/DG-R3-55、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60)全部裁定为良性(build脚本、gh CLI调用、Escape键UI处理、CJK断词正则)。未发现eval、!!js执行、凭据硬编码等恶意模式。
summary.en: Static scan passed: 13 rule matches (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55, DSH-X05/DG-R3-57, DSH-X08/DG-R3-60) were all ruled benign (build scripts, gh CLI calls, Escape key UI handling, CJK word-boundary regex). No malicious patterns such as eval, !!js execution, or hardcoded credentials were found.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无install钩子，无混淆载荷，无凭证文件读取，外联目标仅限GitHub API。客户端网络请求仅限同源路由和GitHub公开API。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, and outbound targets limited to the GitHub API. Client network requests are limited to same-origin routes and the public GitHub API.

summary.zh: AI元数据审查通过：插件未注册工具，无工具描述或系统提示段可投毒。README和代码注释透明说明插件为恶搞/戏仿广告插件。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the plugin registers no tools, and there are no tool descriptions or system prompt sections to poison. The README and code comments transparently state that the plugin is a prank/parody ad plugin.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证。本报告基于静态源码分析和代码审查，未对被审插件执行运行时动态观测。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox validation was performed. This report is based on static source analysis and code review; no runtime dynamic observation was executed on the audited plugin.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行(DG-L4=na)。lib/client.js(12MB)和src/client/builtin-ads.ts(12MB)因超尺寸被机械规则跳过，但通过源码分析已覆盖其内容：lib/client.js为src/client/*.tsx的编译产物，builtin-ads.ts为素材构建脚本生成的数据URI图片。插件为恶搞/戏仿广告插件，代码注释和README对行为有透明说明，所有虚假病毒警告等欺骗性UI属于戏仿范畴，不构成安全威胁。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (DG-L4=na). lib/client.js (12MB) and src/client/builtin-ads.ts (12MB) were skipped by mechanical rules due to size, but their content was covered through source analysis: lib/client.js is the compiled output of src/client/*.tsx, and builtin-ads.ts is a data-URI image generated by the asset build script. The plugin is a prank/parody ad plugin; code comments and README transparently describe its behavior, and all deceptive UI such as fake virus warnings falls within parody and does not constitute a security threat.
